iteration_0.issue: No simulation loop or stepping logic is implemented
iteration_0.impact: No time series (adoption rates) or metrics are produced, preventing any evaluation (RMSE and others) and policy effect analysis
iteration_0.solution: Implement Simulation.run() and a per-step update that: (1) computes layer-weighted peer mask rates, (2) broadcasts information, (3) applies policy from Day 10, (4) updates beliefs and adoption, (5) updates group norms, (6) collects metrics and time series

iteration_0.issue: Training and prediction phases are absent
iteration_0.impact: Cannot fit influence/policy coefficients nor generate predictions for days 30-39; RMSE over holdout is not computable
iteration_0.solution: Add a simple logistic hazard calibration on days 0-29 to estimate alpha (risk), beta (peer), delta (info), gamma (policy), theta (intercept), and optional quadratic peer term; then run forward simulation to predict days 30-39

iteration_0.issue: Data paths are not derived from model_plan.data_folder
iteration_0.impact: Files may not be found in deployments; code silently falls back to synthetic data, making real-world evaluation impossible
iteration_0.solution: Use model_plan['data_folder'] inside Simulation._initialize_from_data_or_synthetic to build AGENTS_FILE, NETWORK_FILE, TRAIN_FILE paths instead of module-level globals

iteration_0.issue: InformationSource and PolicyAuthority are never invoked in a loop
iteration_0.impact: No information or policy effects are present; cannot assess Day-10 policy intervention or information propagation
iteration_0.solution: In each step, randomly broadcast information to agents, set agent.received_info flags, apply PolicyAuthority.issue_or_update_policy(t), enforce_policy(), and broadcast_guidance()

iteration_0.issue: No metrics or validations computed or reported
iteration_0.impact: Cannot evaluate fit (RMSE), adoption dynamics (time_to_threshold, steady_state_adoption), clustering (assortativity), group gaps, or convergence/robustness
iteration_0.solution: Compute and store all specified metrics, output as a stable JSON schema; implement bounds checks, limiting-case sanity tests, and seed robustness

iteration_0.issue: Peer influence is not computed from the network per agent
iteration_0.impact: Adoption decision lacks social context; cannot model diffusion dynamics or clustering
iteration_0.solution: Compute per-agent, per-layer neighbor mask rates excluding ego, aggregate via layer_weights, and feed into adoption hazard
Define prediction period explicitly and ensure the simulation produces and exports adoption_rate for each holdout day
